"# Walkthrough - Pre-Order / Prebooking Access Level Configuration

This walkthrough summarizes the implementation of a dedicated **Prebooking** configuration section within the user-level **POS Access Levels** manager, replacing the global backoffice setting.

---

## Changes Implemented

### 1. Backoffice POS Access Levels
* **Files Modified**: 
  * [POSAccessManager.jsx](file:///c:/Users/Sajad/Desktop/SaSLoop/SaSLoop-dashboard/src/pages/POSAccessManager.jsx)
    * Added the `PreOrder` permission structure to `INITIAL_DEFAULT_STATE`.
    * Rendered a new **Prebooking** section layout containing switches for `New Order` and `Customer Details Mandatory`, along with sub-grids for `Billing`, `Old KOT`, and `Split Bill` (identical to the **Pickup** configuration layout).
  * [brandRoutes.js](file:///c:/Users/Sajad/Desktop/SaSLoop/routes/brandRoutes.js)
    * Updated default database fallback object inside backend user routes to automatically include the `PreOrder` access configuration mapping.
  * [DigitalOrderSettings.jsx](file:///c:/Users/Sajad/Desktop/SaSLoop/SaSLoop-dashboard/src/pages/DigitalOrderSettings.jsx)
    * Removed the redundant global **Customer Details Mandatory for Pre Order** toggle control from Card 7 (Pre Order Settings) since it is now configured per-user under Access Levels.

### 2. POS Settings Interface
* **File Modified**: [App.jsx](file:///c:/Users/Sajad/Desktop/SaSLoop/pos-app/src/App.jsx)

  * Added checkboxes under the **Printers** tab in the POS settings dialog to toggle these options:
    * **Print customer copy for prebooking order**
    * **Print restaurant copy for prebooking order**
